"""List flattening. Implement flatten so the tests pass."""


def flatten(lst):
    """Return a flat list containing every non-list element of lst, in order,
    recursing to ANY depth of nested lists. Non-list elements are kept as-is."""
    result = []
    for item in lst:
        if isinstance(item, list):
            result.extend(flatten(item))
        else:
            result.append(item)
    return result
